role: Watch-side WCSession view-model: activates WCSession, decodes iPhone pushes (liveState ticks, strap state, voice-chat state, start/stop commands, current-state replies) into @Published UI state, drives the Watch's keep-alive HKWorkoutSession off isRecording, and sends Watch→iPhone control requests (start/stop/pause/resume/acknowledge, voice chat, state pull) with reply handling, queueing and timeouts.
types: WatchSessionManager: class (NSObject, ObservableObject, main-actor by target default) — view-model + WCSessionDelegate
WatchSessionManager.InboundMessage: struct (Sendable) — decoded update + command + sorted keys
state: wc out: startVoiceChat, startWorkoutFromWatch, stopWorkoutFromWatch, pauseWorkoutFromWatch, resumeWorkoutFromWatch, acknowledgeFinishedFromWatch, requestCurrentState, requestStrapState, applicationContext(queued intent + expiresAt)
toplevel: Stored-property initializers: statusLine starts "Starting…", sportLabel "Workout", band "—", unitsPreference "metric", voiceChatStateLabel "idle"; displayOnlyMode initializer reads UserDefaults (default true). WCSessionDelegate conformance in the extension at 907.

flags.text: WatchSessionManager.swift is not a member of any test target (only WatchMessageDecoding.swift is, project.pbxproj:4517), so apply/isCurrent ordering, queueControlMessage's stop protection, timeouts and reply handling have no tests.

units.does: Published display-only flag: initial value read from UserDefaults key WatchSessionManager.displayOnlyMode (true when unset or not a Bool); every assignment is written back to UserDefaults in didSet so the mode survives relaunch.
units.entry: Property initializer at WatchSessionManager.init; didSet runs on assignment from applyModeAndPauseState

branches.effect: present: that value; absent or wrong type: ?? true (display-only, iPhone owns the strap)

units.does: Which HR source to display: .directStrap when a direct-strap sample exists and is under directStrapFreshness (4 s) old, else .iPhoneRelay when an iPhone heartRate exists, else .none. Re-evaluated on render; applyDirectStrapHR schedules a re-render when a reading goes stale.

branches.cond: directStrapHeartRateAt set, < directStrapFreshness old, and directStrapHeartRate non-nil

units.does: Displayed HR: the direct-strap bpm when the source is .directStrap, otherwise the iPhone-pushed heartRate (nil for .none).
hrPercentOfMax only while displayedHRSource is .iPhoneRelay; nil while a direct-strap reading is shown (the iPhone percentage was not computed from it).

Records a direct-strap HR sample (directStrapHeartRate = bpm, directStrapHeartRateAt = now), cancels the previous expiry task and schedules one that sleeps directStrapFreshness and then sends objectWillChange, so the screen re-renders and falls back to the relay when the strap goes quiet.

branches.cond: sleep cancelled by a newer sample

units.does: Initialiser: if WCSession is unsupported sets statusLine "iPhone not reachable" and returns; else sets self as WCSession.default delegate, activates it, logs, and sets statusLine "Connecting to phone…".
units.entry: Runs on first access of WatchSessionManager.shared (WatchApp.init / @StateObject initializer)

branches.effect: false: statusLine = phoneUnreachableStatus, return without delegate/activation; true: set delegate then activate

units.does: Stores the workout manager on first call only; if a workout is already recording at that moment (state reply arrived before the view), starts the Watch keep-alive session with the current sportRaw.

branches.effect: true: store it; false: ignore (later calls no-op)

units.does: Talk-button handler: requires WCSession support and reachability and no request already in flight; then marks voice chat in flight, shows "Starting on iPhone…" for 8 s, arms the 10 s timeout, and sends {type: startVoiceChat, ts} live with a reply handler (iOS toggles voice chat).

branches.effect: false: statusLine = "iPhone not reachable" (no hold), return
false: showControlStatus("iPhone not reachable"), return — never queued
false: log and return (duplicate tap dropped silently); true: proceed to send

units.does: Localized "iPhone not reachable" status string.
Sets statusLine to status and holds it for controlStatusHold (8 s) so per-message "Connected" does not overwrite it.

Sends the voice-chat payload with WCSession.sendMessage; the reply handler decodes voiceChatState (default "starting"), needsDisclaimer and refusal off-main, then applies them on the main actor; the error handler fails the request with the error text.
reads: wc:startVoiceChat reply (ok, voiceChatState, needsDisclaimer, errorCode, error)

units.does: Applies the iPhone's voice-chat reply: disclaimer needed → disclaimer status; refusal → clear pending and show the refusal; otherwise set voiceChatStateLabel, clear pending, and show "Voice chat on iPhone: <word>" (voiceChatStateWord, or "Off" for idle/unknown).

branches.effect: false: voiceChatNeedsDisclaimer() and return; true: continue
true: clearVoiceChatPending, showControlStatus(refusal), return; false: accept path

units.does: Clears the pending voice-chat request and shows "Open Emuqu on your iPhone once to turn on voice chat." for 8 s (catalog key handed off, b38).

flags.text: Tells the user to "Open Flo on your iPhone"; the app is named Emuqu (Flo is the assistant), and every other Watch prompt says "Open Emuqu".

units.does: Clears the pending voice-chat request and shows "Couldn't reach iPhone: <message>".
Clears voiceChatRequestInFlight and cancels/nils the voice-chat timeout task.
Cancels any previous voice-chat timeout and starts a 10 s Task; if still in flight afterwards, clears the flag and shows "Tap again — iPhone didn't acknowledge".

branches.cond: self alive and task not cancelled
branches.effect: false: return silently; true: check flag
true: clear flag and show the retry message; false: nothing

units.does: Start-button handler: refuses when WCSession is unsupported or the iPhone unreachable (status "iPhone not reachable"), de-dupes taps via beginStartWorkoutRequest, then sends {type: startWorkoutFromWatch, sport, targetZone?} through sendControlMessage with pending "Starting on iPhone…" and success "Workout started".

branches.effect: false: showControlStatus("iPhone not reachable") and return — start is never queued
false (already in flight): return; true: build payload
true: payload[targetZone] = zone; false: key omitted

units.does: Returns false (and logs) when a start request is already in flight; otherwise sets startWorkoutRequestInFlight, arms the 10 s timeout and returns true.

branches.effect: false: log, return false; true: set flag, arm timeout, return true

units.does: Cancels any previous start timeout and starts a 10 s Task that, if the start is still in flight and not recording, clears the flag and shows "Tap again — iPhone didn't acknowledge".

branches.effect: true: clear flag and show retry text; false: nothing

units.does: End handler: sends {type: WatchMessageDecoding.stopIntentType (stopWorkoutFromWatch)} via sendControlMessage (pending "Stopping on iPhone…", success "Workout stopped").
Pause handler: sends {type: pauseWorkoutFromWatch} via sendControlMessage ("Pausing…" / "Paused").
Resume handler: sends {type: resumeWorkoutFromWatch} via sendControlMessage ("Resuming…" / "Resumed").
Save & Done handler: clears justCompleted locally, then sends {type: acknowledgeFinishedFromWatch} via sendControlMessage ("Saving…" / "Saved").
Common control sender: stamps ts, shows the pending status for 8 s, then sends live with reply handling when the iPhone is reachable, otherwise queues the intent in the application context.

branches.effect: false: statusLine = "iPhone not reachable", return (nothing sent)
false: queueControlMessage (applicationContext) and return; true: sendLiveControlMessage

units.does: Queues a control intent for an unreachable iPhone via updateApplicationContext with withQueueExpiry's expiresAt (12 h for an End, 60 s otherwise); refuses (status "Stopping on iPhone… (open iPhone)") when WatchMessageDecoding.wouldDisplaceQueuedStop says it would replace an unexpired queued End while the iPhone is last known recording; a thrown update shows "Couldn't reach iPhone: <error>".

branches.effect: true: show stopping-status and return without queuing; false: queue
error shown in status line; intent not queued

units.does: Sends a control payload live; the reply handler words the iPhone's answer via controlReplyStatus and the error handler builds "Couldn't reach iPhone: …"; both then call finishControlRequest on the main actor (clearing the start in-flight flag for a start).
Ends a control request: clears the start in-flight state when it was a start, then shows the status for 8 s.

Pulls the live snapshot: returns when WCSession is unsupported, a request is already in flight, or the session is not activated and reachable; otherwise marks the request in flight and sends it (sendCurrentStateRequest). Launch's three callers share one round trip.
Sends {type: requestCurrentState, ts}; the reply is decoded off-actor and applied via finishCurrentStateRequest; an error clears the in-flight flag and is logged.
Clears the in-flight flag and applies the reply.
When WCSession is supported, activated and reachable, sends {type: requestStrapState, ts} with no reply handler; iOS answers with a strapState push applied in apply. Errors are logged.
Decodes a raw message off the main actor into update (decode), command (command) and the sorted key list.

Applies one inbound message: counts it, logs it (DEBUG), drops it whole if isCurrent rejects it, resets metrics on a recording start, applies display fields, recording state and voice-chat state, sets statusLine "Connected to iPhone" when the phone is reachable and no control status is held, then applies any command.

branches.effect: false: return (stale message dropped, including its command); true: continue
true: statusLine = "Connected to iPhone"; false: keep

units.does: DEBUG builds only: logs the first three messages and every tenth with its key list; release builds do nothing.
Applies workout metrics then mode/pause state from the update.
Applies optional metrics, then sets peakHR, elapsedSeconds, distanceMeters, band and elevationGainMeters only when present.
On a liveState snapshot assigns heartRate, hrPercentOfMax, paceDisplay, alpha1, cadenceSpm, targetZone as sent (nil clears); on any other message assigns each only when present.

branches.effect: true: assign all six (absent → nil, shows "—"), return; false: partial path

units.does: Resets all live metrics to blank (nil / 0 / "—") for a new workout.
Sets sportLabel, sportRaw, unitsPreference, displayOnlyMode (persisted via didSet), isPaused and autoPaused when each is present.

When the update carries isRecording: computes justCompleted from the transition, clears the start in-flight state when WatchMessageDecoding.clearsStartWorkoutRequest says so (isRecording true), stores isRecording, and starts/stops the keep-alive session on a transition.

Staleness gate: messages without ts pass; with ts, passes and records it when WatchMessageDecoding.isCurrent accepts it (not older than the newest applied, or the newest applied is over 60 s ahead of the Watch clock after an iPhone clock step back), else rejects.

branches.effect: false: return false; true: store sentAt, return true

flags.text: The staleness gate (the fix for a late stop/tick restarting the keep-alive session) and the rest of WatchSessionManager have no tests: only WatchMessageDecoding is compiled into EmuquTests and no test references WatchSessionManager.

units.does: Starts the workout manager's keep-alive HKWorkoutSession on .started and stops it on .stopped.
If a start request is in flight, clears the flag and cancels the start timeout task.

branches.effect: false: return; true: clear and cancel timeout

units.does: When the update carries voiceChatState: stores it, and if it is non-idle and a voice request is in flight, clears the flag and cancels the timeout.

branches.effect: false: return; true: clear flag and cancel timeout

units.does: Dispatches a decoded command: start (mode-gated), stop the Watch session, apply strap state, ignore liveState/voiceChatState, log unknown verbs.
Starts the Watch workout session for a startWorkout command only when not in display-only mode.
Mirrors the iPhone strap state: sets phoneStrapConnected when present and always sets phoneStrapDeviceName (nil when absent).
Logs an unrecognised message type in DEBUG builds; release discards it.
Elapsed time as h:mm:ss (>= 1 h) or m:ss, in current-locale digits.
α1 formatted to two decimals with the current locale, or "—" when nil.
Distance as miles (imperial) or km with 2 decimals; "—" while 0.
Elevation gain as rounded feet (imperial) or metres; "—" until it is above 0 (as distance shows "—" before any distance).
Cadence as "<n> spm" when present and >= 1, else nil.

branches.effect: false: nil (row shows target zone instead); true: rounded spm

units.does: Formats value in the given unit with MeasurementFormatter (medium style, provided unit, fixed fraction digits).
WCSession activation callback: captures state, error text and reachability off-main, then on the main actor logs, sets isActivated and isReachable and calls applyActivation.
After activation: not activated → "Activation failed"; activated but unreachable → "Waiting for iPhone…"; activated and reachable → pull current state and ask for the iPhone's strap state.

branches.effect: false: status "Waiting for iPhone…", return; true: requestCurrentStateFromPhone

units.does: Reachability callback: hops to the main actor with the new value and calls applyReachability.
Sets isReachable. Unreachable: statusLine "iPhone not reachable" unless a control status is held. Reachable: re-pulls the current state and the iPhone's strap state.

branches.effect: false: unreachable status if not held, return; true: re-pull state and strap state

units.does: Inbound applicationContext: decodes it and applies it on the main actor (staleness gate drops a lingering older tick).
Inbound live message: decodes and applies it on the main actor.
Inbound transferUserInfo: decodes and applies it on the main actor.
